text.tspan: Well, here it is. Despite a problem with my air conditioning unit at home, which took all day
Friday to repair, I have finished the preliminary release of the FALCON030 Product
Specification. Please review it and pass it on to Jerry and Scott for additional comments. I have
made several corrections based on the latest information received from John Hoenig and Tracy
Hall. I am sure there are still some errors. I would like to make final corrections to it by the end
of the week so we have a solid document to go with you to Taiwan.
